Rod diameter 0.32 cm (0.126 in) and minimum length 10.2 cm (4 in)
Vertical mounting and ignition at the bottom
Burn length/consumed specimen length measured
At least ten specimens without consumption greater than 3 cm (1.2 in) for the pressure determination

questions.question: Compare the documented modeling approaches of PSI-115 and PSI-117: what physical process does each model, which computational approach is described, and how does each relate to the earlier SAME or FLEX work? Keep numerical predictions distinct from new ISS observations.
essential_needs: PSI-115 simulates formation and growth of dibutyl-phthalate particles in Earth gravity and microgravity
PSI-115 uses direct numerical simulation with a Navier-Stokes nodal approach and geometry similar to SAME
PSI-117 uses an OpenFOAM three-dimensional CFD droplet-cool-flame model
PSI-117 couples flow, low-temperature chemistry, heat/mass transfer and radiation and compares against FLEX measurements
PSI-117 examines convection, imposed heating and their combination
Methods/predictions remain distinct between studies and are not newly measured ISS outputs
